description: Recorded prices for one product between start_date and end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, both today or earlier), grouped by retailer, each point with its date, price and availability, followed by a ShopSavvy source line. Optionally pass a retailer domain to limit it to one store. Use it to judge whether today's price is a good deal or when a product was cheapest; use product_offers for current prices. History goes back to 2011 for some products and is dense from 2019; the window is capped, so request long periods in narrower slices if the server says the range is too wide. Free without an API key; with a key, 1 credit per day in the window plus 3 (2 with a retailer filter), nothing when no history is found. If no history is returned, say there is no recorded history for that window; do not infer one.

end.description: Alias for 'end_date' (the REST spelling). End date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2024-01-31'). Alias: 'end' (the REST spelling) is also accepted.

identifier.description: Product identifier (barcode, ASIN, URL, model number, product name, or ShopSavvy ID)

retailer.description: Optional: specific retailer domain name to filter results

start.description: Alias for 'start_date' (the REST spelling). Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2024-01-01'). Alias: 'start' (the REST spelling) is also accepted.

name: product_price_history
title: Price history
